title: Microsoft Dataverse: richer record labels for Copilot /mention in Microsoft 365 apps
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, environment setting, licensing description and documented label behaviour are supported. Add the Dataverse security reference to support the general statement about users' security roles.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn describes the enhanced label as Environment Name + App Name + Record Name.
claims.quote: Each record is displayed with an enhanced label that includes the Environment Name + App Name + Record Name, helping users quickly identify the correct record and its source.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope
claims.claim: The offered Dynamics 365 and Power Apps records are the user's most recently viewed records.
claims.quote: Most recently viewed Dynamics 365 and Power Apps records are available in Microsoft 365 Copilot through the /mention experience

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Only records the user has access to are offered through /mention.
claims.quote: Security is top of mind, so only records that a user has access to and most recently used are available in the Microsoft 365 Copilot and productivity apps.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: When a record is viewed through multiple apps, its label reflects the most recently used app.
claims.quote: If you access the same record through multiple apps, the label reflects the most recently used app from which you viewed the record.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: A viewed record can take up to 15 minutes to become available through /mention.
claims.quote: It can take up to 15 minutes after you view a record on your Dynamics 365 or model-driven apps before you can /mention that record on Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in your productivity apps, like Outlook web client.

claims.claim: The /mention documentation covers Outlook on the web.
claims.quote: Link to business records in email messages in your Outlook web client

claims.claim: The /mention documentation covers Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: To reference a recently viewed Dynamics 365 or Power Apps record in Copilot Chat, type / and the first few characters of the record and select the desired record from the suggested list.

claims.claim: The /mention documentation covers Researcher.
claims.quote: you can reference recently viewed Dynamics 365 and Power Apps records in Researcher by typing / followed by a few characters of the record name and selecting the desired record from the suggested list.

claims.claim: The documentation covers using referenced business records in Word.
claims.quote: Use Copilot to draft a status update in Word

claims.claim: The documentation covers using referenced business records in Teams.
claims.quote: Ask Copilot to create a meeting agenda in Teams

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The email recipient needs environment access and security roles granting access to the shared data.
claims.quote: The recipient of the email must have access to the environment with security roles that grant access to the data and must be able to access the shared record.

claims.claim: Users' access to the underlying Dataverse records follows Dataverse security roles.
claims.quote: A combination of access levels and permissions in a security role determines which apps and data users can view and how they can interact with those apps and data.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/database-security to sources for the general claim about users' Dataverse security roles; the /mention page explicitly names security roles for the email recipient.

claims.claim: Copilot uses the referenced record as context to ground its response.
claims.quote: Copilot uses the referenced record as context to ground its response and perform actions against the relevant business data.

claims.claim: The page says Copilot can perform actions against the relevant business data.
claims.quote: Copilot uses the referenced record as context to ground its response and perform actions against the relevant business data.

claims.claim: The /mention page does not enumerate which actions against the referenced business data are supported.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention Copilot available actions business record supported actions; opened learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web. It gives usage examples, not an enumeration of supported business-data operations.

claims.claim: Learn does not further describe the /mention-specific authorisation mechanism beyond access requirements.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention authorization security actions; Dataverse /mention authorization. Opened learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web and /database-security; no further /mention-specific authorisation mechanism found.

claims.claim: The UI path is Power Platform admin center > Manage > Environments > environment > Settings > Product > Features > Search > Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. ... select Environments. ... select an environment. ... select Settings. ... Expand Product, and then select Features. ... Under the Search section, turn on Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps.

claims.where: controls[0].governs and scope; summary; Scope; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps is an environment-scoped control for /mention business-record availability generally.
claims.quote: When you turn on this setting, you can link to business records in productivity apps by using the /mention feature. ... On the Environments page, select an environment.

claims.claim: No API or automation operation for this specific /mention setting is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps API PowerShell; Dataverse Context IQ search records environment setting API OrgDBOrgSettings. Opened /admin/link-records-outlook-web, /developer/data-platform/organization-table and its Organization reference; no mapped operation found.

claims.claim: No separate switch for the enhanced label format is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse Copilot mention enhanced labels default enabled label format switch licensing price meter; /mention label switch Dataverse. Opened learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web and /settings-features; no label-format switch found.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: Manage feature settings lists the general Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps setting's default as On.
claims.quote: | Search for records in Microsoft 365 apps | You can quickly enable your users to access the records they most recently used in their application. The records are available in the Outlook Web client using a simple /mention gesture. | On |

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The default state of the new label enhancement itself, distinct from the existing /mention setting, is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention enhanced label automatically enable configuration; Dataverse record /mention labels default. Read roadmap, /admin/link-records-outlook-web and /settings-features; they give the general setting's default but not the label enhancement's arrival behaviour.

claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible subscription plans.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans.

claims.claim: The label enhancement is included within the licensing of the Microsoft Copilot product it enhances.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate licensing requirement specific to the enhanced labels is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention license labels; Dataverse /mention enhanced label licensing pricing. Opened /power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web, /pricing-billing-skus and /copilot/plan/copilot-license-options; none states a separate enhanced-label entitlement.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The /mention Learn page names no licence.
claims.quote: Searched: link-records-outlook-web license; Dataverse /mention license labels. Read the full learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web page; it documents the setting and usage, but names no licence.

claims.claim: The /mention Learn page names no billing meter.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention meter charge. Read the full learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web page; it contains no meter or billing rate.

claims.claim: The supplied roadmap record names neither a licence nor a meter.
claims.quote: End users of Microsoft 365 Copilot will see improved Microsoft Dataverse, Dynamics 365, and Power Apps record references in Context IQ with richer, more descriptive labels that include environment, app, and table information.

claims.claim: No charge for the /mention setting itself is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention meter charge; Dataverse /mention enhanced label licensing pricing. Opened /power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web, /pricing-billing-skus and /copilot/plan/copilot-license-options; no fee for this setting found.

claims.claim: No separate meter for the label enhancement is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention meter charge; Dataverse Copilot mention enhanced labels default enabled label format switch licensing price meter. Opened /power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web, /pricing-billing-skus and Copilot licence options; no enhanced-label meter found.

claims.claim: Manage feature settings requires the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.
claims.quote: Ensure you have the System Administrator security role or equivalent permissions to update the settings.

claims.claim: The /mention page itself does not name the role required to configure the setting.
claims.quote: Searched: Dataverse /mention authorization security actions; read the full /power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web page and the prerequisites in /settings-features. The /mention page names recipient security roles generically, not the administrator's configuration role.

claims.claim: The referenced records come from Dynamics 365 and model-driven Power Apps.
claims.quote: It can take up to 15 minutes after you view a record on your Dynamics 365 or model-driven apps before you can /mention that record on Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in your productivity apps, like Outlook web client.
